hypothesis.causal_change: A distinct postbuild verifier supplies bounded evidence that permits either unchanged passage or narrowly grounded repair or rollback.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Clean provisional policies should remain unchanged while witnessed defects receive only bounded evidence-grounded intervention.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsified unless the emitted policy artifact is all-valid and satisfies the median promotion contract.
hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Construction-time checks can miss defects observable only in the realized provisional artifact.

structure.information_flow: The first call runs the anchor workflow unchanged and emits one complete provisional policy artifact. A distinct verifier converts that realized artifact into a bounded packet of executable counterexamples or a no-failure certificate. The final integrator must emit that same artifact unchanged when the packet is empty; otherwise it performs only packet-grounded repair or exact rollback and emits the single final policy artifact.
structure.name: Postbuild Independent Falsification and Bounded Integration

calls.objective: Starting from anchor_policy, execute the anchor's existing ordered transactional repair, insertion-time intervention, exact-delta rollback, and terminal singleton-ablation workflow without adding a new repair or compression rule. Emit exactly one complete contract-compliant provisional policy artifact; do not generate alternatives.

Inspect and exercise the single draft_policy against task requirements, interface and authoritative-state obligations, reproducible differential probes against anchor_policy, and failure modes exposed by its realized changes. Return a bounded evidence-only analysis packet containing reproducible witnesses, implicated changed regions, required preservation checks, and exact reproduction procedures; if none are found, return an explicit no-failure certificate. Do not propose another policy, rank alternatives, or author policy code.

Consume the sole draft_policy and postbuild_falsification_packet. If the packet certifies no failure, emit the draft policy unchanged. Otherwise reproduce each witness, apply one minimal packet-grounded repair or exact rollback of the implicated draft delta, replay all packet witnesses and baseline interface, authoritative-state, and capacity checks, and emit exactly one complete contract-compliant policy artifact. Do not reopen broad diagnosis, create alternatives, or select among versions.
